cta_browse: What are you looking for today? Tell me a product name, or send a product code.
goodbye: Thanks for visiting {shop}! Message us any time. 🙏
not_understood: Sorry, I didn't quite get that.
cta_more: Is there anything else I can help you find?
welcome_back: Welcome back! You have {items} in your cart.
welcome_back_short: Welcome back! You have {n} {item_word} in your cart.
welcome_back_stale: Hi! 👋 Welcome back to {shop}. This is still in your cart:
stale_cta: Would you like to continue with this order?
rm_cta: Which item would you like to remove, or what else can I help with?
browse_cta: Would you like to browse what we have?
category_not_found: Sorry, we don't have "{q}". We have: {cats}.
category_empty: Sorry, {cat} is sold out right now.
browse_empty: We don't have anything listed right now — please check back soon.
list_cta: Which one would you like to see? Reply with its number or code.
card_cta: Would you like to order this?
sold_out: Sorry, {name} is sold out right now.
alts_cta: Would you like to see any of these?
image_unknown: I couldn't find a close match for that photo. Share a product code or tell me what you're looking for.
retry_later: Sorry, one moment — could you send that again?
ack_autofill: ℹ️ Only {value} is available{for_what}, so I selected it.
ack_cancel_blocked: Your order #{number} is already with our team for payment verification, so I can't cancel it here.
images_none: I don't have photos of {name} yet.
ack_dropped: ⚠️ {what} is no longer available, so I took it out of your cart.
r_OUT_OF_STOCK_VARIANT: Sorry, {product} in {value} is sold out right now.
r_AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT: "{value}" could mean more than one of our {attrs}.
r_QTY_EXCEEDS_STOCK_one: Only 1 of {what} is available right now.
r_QTY_EXCEEDS_STOCK_many: Only {available} of {what} are available right now.
r_QTY_MISMATCH: That adds up to {got}, but the order is for {expected}.
r_UNKNOWN_SKU: I couldn't find that product code.
r_INVALID_NAME: I couldn't read that as a name.
r_INVALID_ADDRESS_no_structure: That address needs a bit more detail (house / street, area, city).
r_INVALID_ADDRESS_bad_pincode: The pincode looks wrong — it should be 6 digits.
r_INVALID_MOBILE: That doesn't look like a 10-digit mobile number.
r_PAYMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED: Sorry, that payment method isn't available with this shop.
r_UPI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Payment details for this order are still being set up — the seller will message you here shortly.
q_color: Which colour would you like{for_what}? Available: {options}.
q_quantity_max: How many would you like{for_what}? (up to {available})
q_split_plain: Which colours and how many of each?
q_variant: Which one would you like{for_what}? Available: {options}.
q_name: May I have your name for the delivery?
q_address: Please share your complete delivery address with the 6-digit pincode.
q_mobile: Please share a 10-digit contact number for the delivery.
q_payment: How would you like to pay? Available: {options}.
q_change: No problem — what would you like to change? (e.g. colour, size, quantity, address, payment)
q_other: Could you tell me a bit more about what you'd like?
sum_upsell: ➕ Many customers also add {name} ({price}). Want to add it?
cancel_cart: Okay, I've cancelled this order. Would you like to look at something else?
cancel_order: Your order #{number} has been cancelled. Would you like to look at something else?
cancel_blocked: Your order #{number} is already with our team for payment verification, so I can't cancel it here. Would you like me to connect you with someone?
cancel_nothing: There's nothing to cancel right now. What can I help you find?
handoff: Our team will reply here shortly. 🙏
pending_pay: Your order #{number} is waiting for payment.
pending_review: Your order #{number} is being verified — I'll update you here as soon as it's approved.
pending_meanwhile: Meanwhile, let's set up your new order 😊
llm_down: Sorry, I'm having trouble understanding right now.
q_qty_stock_choice: What would you like to do? You can also type a quantity (up to {available}).
oedit_yes_hint: Reply YES to update it or NO to keep it as it is.
oedit_pay_new: Please pay the NEW amount below. The earlier payment request for this order no longer applies.
oedit_kept: No problem — order #{number} stays as it is ({items}, {total}).
oedit_blocked_proof: Order #{number} already has a payment screenshot under review, so I can't change it here. Would you like a new order for {items}?
oedit_blocked_paid: Order #{number} is already confirmed, so I can't change it here. Would you like a new order for {items}?
oedit_new_hint: Reply YES to start a new order.
oedit_need_attr: {what} isn't available in {have}. Available: {options}. Which one would you like for {what}?
oedit_unavailable: Sorry, {what} isn't available for {product} right now.
oedit_stock_short: Only {n} left of {what}, so I can't make that change.
oedit_expired: That change request has expired. Tell me again what you'd like to change.
oedit_failed: Sorry, I couldn't update the order just now. Your order is unchanged — please try again, or type 'talk to someone'.
image_blank: That picture looks blank or too dark to read 📷 Could you send it again?
